govdocs-archive_org-nsia-KingAG-DAGRecor: This summons — SCLC v. Kelley et al., C.A. 76-1185 — is a court file. The SCLC sued the FBI over surveillance. The suit mattered. The file belongs to the legal archive. The item is a fragment of the legal record.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-andrew-krzyck: This 1913 reference piece on Andrzej Krzycki — the Polish humanist archbishop. Stanislaus Tarnowski praises his Latin verse. His pen served church and crown. The Renaissance bloomed in Poland. A primate with a poet's soul. His satires mocked the courtly vices. His verses graced the royal court.
